title: Bio-degradable electrospun nanofibers encompassing dioxidovanadium benzimidazole compounds as potential drug delivery systems for diabetes mellitus
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,27994-28003
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01655C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sanam Maikoo, Mongezi Majebe, Andile Khathi, Allen Mambanda, Bongeka Mshengu, Lindokuhle Patience Mabuza, Phikelelani Ngubane, Irvin Noel Booysen
Respective vanadium compounds with bidentate benzimidazole chelators were incorporated into biodegradable electrospun nanofibers (ENFs). The resultant nanocomposites illustrated time-dependent drug release profiles and glucose-lowering activities.
